title.narrative: Enhancing the efforts on shedding light on the fate of missing persons in Kosovo

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the action is to support the efforts of relevant stakeholders on shedding light to the fate of missing persons through promoting accountability, bottom-up approach, social dialogue and providing relevant valuable information to the families of missing persons in Kosovo.

This objective will be attained through strategic and structural efforts in addressing: 1) responsibilities of relevant stakeholders on shedding light to the fate of missing persons; 2) the legal framework and policies on missing persons; 3) the cooperation between relevant stakeholders and groups of interest and 4) the role of public art in tackling important issues of dealing with the past (DwP), respectively the issue of missing persons.

The specific objectives are:

Specific Objective 1 (SO1) ¿ Supporting the implementation of the legal framework and the obligations that have emerged from the joint Declaration for Missing Persons between Kosovo and Serbia, issued on May 2, 2023.

Specific Objective 2 (SO2) ¿ Bringing the issue of missing persons as part of an internal dialogue between the most relevant stakeholders and groups of interest.

Specific Objective 3 (SO3) ¿ Utilizing public art as though-provoking memorials, advocating for the rights of family members of missing persons and raising awareness about the issue.

Specific Objective 4 (SO4) ¿ Providing information, support and updates to the families of missing persons..
